name: Donair
tagline: Agentic event fundraising: finds likely donors, runs a live donation portal and tracks results.

awards: Talsom - Sponsor Challenge // Talsom - Défi commandité
Front Row Ventures - Investor Pitch Award

problem: Event fundraising relies on slow donor research and big sponsors.
solution: Describe the event and goal; Gemini with embeddings identifies target donors; a live portal takes payments including on-chain ones with live incentive trackers; analytics follow.
demo_moment: Team-described: set up an event, go live and watch donations arrive.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Talsom - Sponsor Challenge // Talsom - Défi commandité” and “Front Row Ventures - Investor Pitch Award” among 260 submissions.
Also won a pitch meeting with a venture firm.

lessons: Cover before, during and after the event to look like a product.
